per_contract_iv.definition: Find sigma >= 0 such that a contract-appropriate option pricing model price(S,K,T,r,q,sigma,exercise_style) equals a validated observed option price.
blocked_reasons: No per-contract IV field exists in the preserved response.
No synchronized underlying spot observation is present.
Expiration time, validated rate/dividend inputs, and exercise-model contract are absent.

iv_rank.equal_min_max_policy: Undefined; return unavailable rather than divide by zero.

iv_percentile.tie_policy: Strict-less-than; historical values equal to current IV are not counted below it.

historical_volatility.definition: For N consecutive verified close-to-close log returns r_t=ln(C_t/C_(t-1)), sample_stddev(r) * sqrt(252).
historical_volatility.missing_session_policy: Reject the window unless every expected trading session is verified; do not bridge missing sessions.

intraday_realized_volatility.definition: sqrt(sum of squared intraday log returns under a declared sampling interval and overnight-session policy), annualization only if the sampling contract specifies it.

iv_skew.definition: Not frozen: requires a declared strike-based or delta-based skew definition and comparable verified per-contract IV observations.

iv_term_structure.definition: Compare expiration-level IV summaries only after one consistent contract-selection and tenor methodology is frozen.

production_policy: A known formula does not make an indicator data-ready, implementation-ready, or display-ready. Missing required inputs keep the metric unavailable; no placeholder number is emitted.
